                              ANNUAL REPORT
                                   2020 年 報




                                        梅西

                        谷愛凌




Annual Report 2020 年報
CORPORATE   China Mengniu Dairy Company Limited (the “Company”; stock code:
            2319) and its subsidiaries (collectively the “Group” or “Mengniu”)
PROFILE     mainly manufacture and distribute quality dairy products in China. It is
            one of the leading dairy product manufacturers in China, with
公司簡介        MENGNIU as its core brand. Mengniu’s diversified products include
            liquid milk, ice cream, milk formula and other products such as
            cheese. In 2020, Mengniu moved up to the eighth place on the
            “Global Dairy Top 20” list published by Rabobank. By the end of
            December 2020, the Group’s annual production capacity of dairy
            products reached 9.90 million tons. In March 2014, Mengniu became
            a Hang Seng Index constituent, making it the first blue chip Chinese
            dairy product enterprise. In August 2020, Mengniu was included as a
            constituent of the Hang Seng Corporate Sustainability Index and the
            Hang Seng ESG50 Index.

            中國蒙牛乳業有限公司（「本公司」；股份代號：2319）及其子公司（統
            稱「本集團」或「蒙牛」）主要於中國生產及銷售優質乳製品。憑藉其主
            要品牌蒙牛 ，蒙牛已成為中國領先的乳製品生產商之一。蒙牛提供多
            元化的產品，包括液態奶、冰淇淋、奶粉及其他產品例如奶酪等。於
            二零二零年，蒙牛在荷蘭合作銀行的「全球乳業20強」排行榜中躍升至
            第八位。截至二零二零年十二月底，本集團乳製品的年生產能力達990
            萬噸。二零一四年三月，蒙牛獲納入恒生指數成份股，成為首家中國
            乳製品企業藍籌股。二零二零年八月，蒙牛獲納入香港恒生可持續發
            展企業指數及恒生ESG50指數成分股。

                                                                                          CEO’S STATEMENT
                                                                                                   總裁致辭




2020 was a very unusual year with the outbreak of the Covid-19          二零二零年是極不平凡的一年，突發而來的一場
Epidemic (the “Epidemic”) sweeping across the world and to date         疫情席捲全球，至今仍在許多國家肆虐。但是，
many countries are still struggling to cope. However, in China,         在中央政府的領導及全體社會的共同努力下，國
under the leadership of the central government and with                 內疫情防控取得了重大的成果。在全體蒙牛人及
cooperation from the general public, efforts to prevent and control     合作夥伴們的齊心協力下，蒙牛業務繼續高質量
the Epidemic have been successful. And, for Mengniu, working in         高速發展。
concert with its employees and business partners, it was able to
maintain quality and rapid development during the year.

Four years ago, Mengniu began its organization restructuring and        早於四年前，蒙牛已開始大刀闊斧地進行架構調
brand building with resolution, deployed its milk sources with          整，極具魄力地開展品牌建設，前瞻性地開展奶
foresight and promoted its internationalization strategy steadfastly.   源佈局，堅定地推進國際化戰略，令本集團踏上

PROSPECTS                                                            展望
In 2020, Mengniu flexibly adjusted its business strategy, which      二零二零年，蒙牛靈活調整業務策略，成功緊抓

   An associate is an entity in which the Group has a long            聯營公司指本集團持有其一般不少於20%
   term interest of generally not less than 20% of the equity         投票權的長期權益而對其有重要影響力的

   significant influence. Significant influence is the power to       財政及營運政策決定而非對該等政策施加
   participate in the financial and operating policy decisions of     控制或共同控制。
   the investee, but is not control or joint control over those
   policies.

   A joint venture is a type of joint arrangement whereby the         合營企業屬共同安排，據此，擁有該安排共
   parties that have joint control of the arrangement have rights     同控制權的訂約方有權享有合營企業的資
   to the net assets of the joint venture. Joint control is the       產淨值。共同控制權指按照合約協定對一
   contractually agreed sharing of control of an arrangement,         項安排所共有的控制權，僅在相關活動必
   which exists only when decisions about the relevant                須獲得共同享有控制權的各方一致同意方
   activities require the unanimous consent of the parties            能決定時存在。
   sharing control.

   The Group’s investments in associates and joint ventures           本集團於聯營公司及合營企業的投資乃採
   are stated in the consolidated statement of financial position     用權益會計法按本集團所佔資產淨值減任
   at the Group’s share of net assets under the equity method         何減值損失於綜合財務狀況表列賬。
   of accounting, less any impairment losses.

   Adjustments are made to bring into line any dissimilar             任何可能存在的相異會計政策已相應作出
   accounting policies that may exist.                                調整，以使之貫徹一致。

   The Group’s share of the post-acquisition results and other        本集團所佔聯營公司及合營企業的收購後

   addition, when there has been a change recognised directly         會（如適用）於綜合權益變動表內確認其任
   in the equity of the associate or joint venture, the Group         何應佔變動。本集團與其聯營公司或合營
   recognises its share of any changes, when applicable, in the       企業之間交易所產生的未變現收益及虧損，
   consolidated statement of changes in equity. Unrealised            均以本集團於聯營公司或合營企業的投資

      Fair value measurement                                                公允值計量
      The Group measures its share options, certain financial               於各報告期末，本集團按公允值計量其購
      assets, derivative financial instruments and certain other            股權、若干金融資產、衍生金融工具及若干
      borrowings at fair value at the end of each reporting period.         其他借貸。公允值為於計量日市場參與者
      Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an             於有秩序交易中出售資產可收取或轉讓負
      asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction       債須支付的價格。公允值計量乃基於假設
      between market participants at the measurement date. The              出售資產或轉移負債的交易於資產或負債
      fair value measurement is based on the presumption that               的主要市場或於未有主要市場的情況下，
      the transaction to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes     則於資產或負債的最有利市場進行。主要
      place either in the principal market for the asset or liability,      或最有利市場須位於本集團能到達的地方。
      or in the absence of a principal market, in the most                  資產或負債的公允值乃基於市場參與者為
      advantageous market for the asset or liability. The principal         資產或負債定價所用的假設計量（假設市場
      or the most advantageous market must be accessible by                 參與者依照彼等的最佳經濟利益行事）。
      the Group. The fair value of an asset or a liability is
      measured using the assumptions that market participants
      would use when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that
      market participants act in their economic best interest.

      A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into          以公允值計量非金融資產，應當考慮市場
      account a market participant’s ability to generate economic           參與者將該資產用於最佳用途產生經濟利
      benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use or by         益的能力，或者將該資產出售予能夠用於
      selling it to another market participant that would use the           最佳用途的其他市場參與者產生經濟利益
      asset in its highest and best use.                                    的能力。

      The Group’s business model for managing financial assets          本集團管理金融資產的業務模式指本集團
      refers to how it manages its financial assets in order to         如何管理其金融資產以產生現金流量。業
      generate cash flows. The business model determines                務模式釐定現金流量是否因收取合約現金
      whether cash flows will result from collecting contractual        流量、出售金融資產或因前述兩者而引起。
      cash flows, selling the financial assets, or both. Financial      已分類及按攤餘成本計量的金融資產為以
      assets classified and measured at amortised cost are held         持有金融資產以收回合約現金流量為目的
      within a business model with the objective to hold financial      之業務模式內持有，而已分類及按公允值
      assets in order to collect contractual cash flows, while          計量計入其他全面收益的金融資產為以持
      financial assets classified and measured at fair value            作收回合約現金流量及出售為目的之業務
      through other comprehensive income are held within a              模式內持有。並非以上述業務模式內持有
      business model with the objective of both holding to collect      之金融資產則分類及按公允值計量計入損
      contractual cash flows and selling. Financial assets which        益。

      Impairment of financial assets                                      金融資產減值
      The Group recognises an allowance for expected credit               本集團就所有並非按公允值計入損益持有
      losses (“ECLs”) for all debt instruments not held at fair value     的債務工具確認預期信貸虧損（「預期信貸
      through profit or loss. ECLs are based on the difference            虧損」）。預期信貸虧損乃以根據合約應付
      between the contractual cash flows due in accordance with           的合約現金流量與本集團預期收取的所有
      the contract and all the cash flows that the Group expects          現金流量之間的差額為基準，按原有實際
      to receive, discounted at an approximation of the original          利率相近的差額貼現。預期現金流量將包
      effective interest rate. The expected cash flows will include       括來自銷售所持有抵押品或其他信用增級
      cash flows from the sale of collateral held or other credit         的現金流量，此乃合約條不可或缺的部分。
      enhancements that are integral to the contractual terms.

      General approach                                                    一般方法
      ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures             預期信貸虧損於兩個階段進行確認。對於
      for which there has not been a significant increase in credit       自初始確認後並無顯著增加的信貸風險，
      risk since initial recognition, ECLs are provided for credit        預期信貸虧損就可能於未來12個月內出現
      losses that result from default events that are possible            的 違 約 事 件 計 提 撥 備（12個 月 預 期 信 貸 虧
      within the next 12 months (a 12-month ECL). For those               損）。對於自初始確認後有顯著增加的信貸
      credit exposures for which there has been a significant             風險，須在信貸虧損預期的剩餘年期計提
      increase in credit risk since initial recognition, a loss           虧損撥備，不論違約事件於何時發生（存續
      allowance is required for credit losses expected over the           期預期信貸虧損）。
      remaining life of the exposure, irrespective of the timing of
      the default (a lifetime ECL).

      At each reporting date, the Group assesses whether the              於各報告日期，本集團評估自初始確認後
      credit risk on a financial instrument has increased                 金融工具的信貸風險是否顯著增加。本集
      significantly since initial recognition. When making the            團作出評估時會對於報告日期金融工具發
      assessment, the Group compares the risk of a default                生的違約風險及於初始確認日期起金融工
      occurring on the financial instrument as at the reporting           具發生的違約風險進行比較，並考慮無需
      date with the risk of a default occurring on the financial          付出不必要成本或努力而可得到的合理及
      instrument as at the date of initial recognition and considers      可支持資料，包括歷史及前瞻性資料。
      reasonable and supportable information that is available
      without undue cost or effort, including historical and
      forward-looking information.

    For the purpose of hedge accounting, hedges are classified          就對沖會計而言，對沖分類為：
    as:

    •    fair value hedges when hedging the exposure to                 •   公允值對沖，即對沖某項已確認資產

         liability or an unrecognised firm commitment; or                   認已承諾承擔；或

    •    cash flow hedges when hedging the exposure to                  •   現金流量對沖，即對沖現金流量變動
         variability in cash flows that is either attributable to a         風險，該風險屬某項已確認資產或負
         particular risk associated with a recognised asset or              債或某項很可能發生的預計交易相關
         liability or a highly probable forecast transaction, or a          特定風險，或未確認的已承諾承擔的
         foreign currency risk in an unrecognised firm                      外匯風險；或
         commitment; or

    •    hedges of a net investment in a foreign operation.             •   對沖於海外業務的投資淨額。

    At the inception of a hedge relationship, the Group formally        對沖關係開始時，本集團正式指定及以文
    designates and documents the hedge relationship to which            件記錄本集團有意採用對沖會計處理的對
    the Group wishes to apply hedge accounting, the risk                沖關係、風險管理目標及其進行對沖的策

    hedge.

    hedged and how the Group will assess whether the                    沖關係是否符合對沖有效性規定（包括其對
    hedging relationship meets the hedge effectiveness                  對沖無效性來源的分析及對沖比率如何釐
    requirements (including the analysis of sources of hedge            定）。對沖關係於達成以下全部有效性規定
    ineffectiveness and how the hedge ratio is determined). A           時，方可合資格採用對沖會計處理：

      necessary to obtain an asset of a similar value to the right-         押品借入所需資金應支付之利率。因此，
      of-use asset in a similar economic environment. The IBR               增 量 借 貸 利 率 反 映 了 本 集 團「應 支 付」利
      therefore reflects what the Group “would have to pay”,                率，當無可觀察利率時（如就並無訂立融資
      which requires estimation when no observable rates are                交易之子公司而言），或當須對利率進行調

      financing transactions) or when it needs to be adjusted to            非以子公司之功能貨幣訂立時），則須作出
      reflect the terms and conditions of the lease (for example,           利率估計。當可觀察輸入數據可用時，本集

33. DEFERRED INCOME                                                     33. 遞延收入
      Various local government authorities have granted certain           多個地方政府當局無償向本集團授予若干

39. SHARE AWARD SCHEME                                                 39. 股票獎勵計劃
      The share award scheme of the Company was adopted by               本公司股票獎勵計劃於二零一三年三月
      the board on 26 March 2013 (the “Adoption Date”). The              二十六日（「採納日期」）獲董事會採納。股
      purpose of the share award scheme is to provide an                 票獎勵計劃旨在獎勵參與者繼續為本集團
      incentive to encourage the participants for the continual          的經營及發展作出貢獻。
      operation and development of the Group.

      Subject to the terms of the share award scheme and the             根據股票獎勵計劃條款及上市規則，董事
      Listing Rules, the board may at any time make an offer to          會可隨時向任何合資格人士作出要約，由
      any eligible person whom it may in its absolute discretion         合資格人士絕對酌情選擇接納董事會決定
      select to accept the grant of an award over such a number          授出的有關股份數目之獎勵（「參與者」）。
      of shares as it may determine (the “Participants”). Existing       股票獎勵計劃的獨立受託人（「受託人」）以
      shares of the Company will be purchased by an                      本集團出資的現金於市場上購買本公司現
      independent trustee (the “Trustee”) of the share award             有股份，及以信託形式代相關參與者持有，
      scheme from the market out of cash contributed by the              直至該等股份根據股票獎勵計劃的條文歸
      Group and be held in trust for the relevant Participants until     屬於相關參與為止。已授出及由受託人持
      such shares are vested with the relevant Participants in           有直至歸屬的本公司股份稱為庫存股份，
      accordance with the provisions of the share award scheme.          而各庫存股份應指本公司一股普通股。
      The shares of the Company granted and held by the
      trustee until vesting are referred to as the treasury shares
      and each treasury share shall represent one ordinary share
      of the Company.

      No shares shall be purchased pursuant to the share award           概無股份根據本股票獎勵計劃獲購買，亦
      scheme, nor any amounts paid to the Trustee for the                無向受託人支付任何款項以作出有關購買，
      purpose of making such a purchase, if as a result of such          倘因有關購買，致使本股票獎勵計劃管理
      purchase, the number of shares administered under the              的股份數目超過本公司已發行股本5%，於

      aggregate may not exceed 0.5% of the issued capital of the

    OBJECTIVES AND POLICIES
      Financial risk management                                           財務風險管理
      The Group’s principal financial instruments, other than             本集團的主要金融工具（衍生工具除外）包
      derivatives, comprise cash and cash equivalents, trade and          括現金及現金等價物、應收及應付賬款及
      bills receivables and payables, other receivables and               票據、其他應收及應付款項、與關聯人士的
      payables, long term receivables balances with related               長期應收結餘、計息銀行及其他借貸及長
      parties, interest-bearing bank and other borrowings and long        期應付款項。該等金融工具旨在為本集團
      term payables. The main purpose of these financial                  的營運籌集資金。本集團擁有各式各樣直
      instruments is to raise finance for the Group’s operations.         接來自其業務的其他金融資產及負債，例
      The Group has various other financial assets and liabilities        如應收賬款及應付賬款。
      such as trade receivables and trade payables, which arise
      directly from its operations.

      The Group also entered into derivative transactions, mainly         本集團亦訂立衍生交易，主要為利率互換
      interests rate swaps, forward currency swaps and interest           合約、遠期貨幣掉期及利率遠期合約，目的
      rate forward contracts. The purpose is to manage the                為管理本集團業務所產生的匯率及浮動利
      exchange rate and floating rate exposures arising from the          率風險。
      Group’s operations.

      The main risks arising from the Group’s financial                   來自本集團金融工具的主要風險有利率風
      instruments are interest rate risk, foreign currency risk,          險、外幣風險、信貸風險、流動性風險及股
      credit risk, liquidity risk and equity price risk. The board of     本價格風險。董事會及高級管理人員定期
      directors and senior management meet periodically to                舉行會議，分析本集團所承受的風險，並制
      analyse and formulate measures to manage the Group’s                定用以管理風險的措施。本集團一般採納
      exposure to these risks. Generally, the Group adopts                審慎的策略管理風險。
      prudent strategies on its risk management.

            periodic reviews and evaluations of its debt portfolio              集團的銀行貸款利率及還款期於財務

      Capital management                                               資本管理
      The primary objectives of the Group’s capital management         本集團資本管理的基本目標乃維持本集團
      are to safeguard the Group’s ability to continue as a going      持續經營的能力及保持穩健的資本比率，
      concern and to maintain healthy capital ratios in order to       以支持其業務及提高股東價值。
      support its business and maximise shareholders’ value.

      The Group manages its capital structure and makes                本集團管理其資本架構，並因應經濟環境
      adjustments to it in light of changes in economic conditions     的變化及相關資產的風險特徵作出調整。
      and the risk characteristics of the underlying assets. To        為維持或調整資本架構，本集團可能會調
      maintain or adjust the capital structure, the Group may          整派付予股東的股息、股東的資本回報或
      adjust the dividend payment to shareholders, return capital      發行新股。截至二零二零年十二月三十一

    The Group monitors capital using a gearing ratio, which is       本集團以資本負債比率監控資本，資本負
    net debt divided by the capital plus net debt. Net debt          債比率即淨負債除以資本總額加上淨負債
    includes interest-bearing bank and other borrowings, trade       之和。淨負債包括計息銀行及其他借貸、
    and bills payables, other payables and accruals, long term       應付賬款及票據、其他應付款項及預提費
    payables and other financial liabilities, less cash and bank     用、長期應付款項，以及其他金融負債，減
    balances and long term time deposits, and excludes               現金及銀行結存及長期定期存款，並不包
    disposal groups. Capital represents equity attributable to       括處置組。資本指本公司擁有人應佔權益。
    owners of the Company. The gearing ratios as at the end of       於報告期末的資本負債比率如下：
